text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I guess mile races really are my
forte. I
always feel so confident while I
run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The champion? Oh, you're talking about
the Mile
Championship!
choice_data_list: 次はチャンピオンをとるぞ！
次はチャンピオンをとろう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's take the championship next time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I'm up to the challenge
now. Let's
ride this wave and keep on
winning!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we decide to make the Mile

Championship our next goal.
